prior.note: The revised orbit rule leaves two thrust choices valid at once: with the nose within 45°, speed above circularSpeed(r) + SPEED_SLACK, and velocity more than 10° off the desired direction, both +1 and −1 apply (spec L46). Specify which takes precedence; the choices produce different flight paths.

The revised bait rule identifies every body struck in a tick through per-body graceUntil and applies the distance test to that body (spec L69-L76). The source confirms the grace update and body indexing (contacts.ts:L16-L18, L42-L45; state.ts:L18-L20).

verified: The revised hazard order and asteroid tie break are explicit (spec L36-L41); predictPath returns positions and stops at first solid contact (predict.ts:L21-L30).
The proposed orbit correction uses thrust to change velocity, consistent with flyShip (spec L43-L48; physics.ts:L25-L54).
